user.title: Create Window Group
user.description: Configure a window group with shared facade orientation and slat geometry. You can add covers to this group after setup.

data_description.name: A descriptive name for this window group (e.g., 'South Windows')
data_description.slat_width_mm: Width of each slat in millimeters

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Window Group
reconfigure.description: Update the facade orientation and slat geometry for this window group.

data_description.slat_width_mm: Width of each slat in millimeters

abort.already_configured: A window group with this name already exists.

user.title: Add Cover to Group
user.description: Select a cover entity and configure its behavior.

data.name: Custom name (optional)
data.no_sun_behavior: Behavior when sun is behind facade

data_description.name: Optional custom name for this cover
data_description.drive_position: Position to drive cover to before tilting (0%=closed, 100%=open)
data_description.invert_tilt_percent: Invert tilt percent if cover uses reversed semantics
data_description.no_sun_behavior: What to do when sun is below horizon or behind facade
data_description.respect_manual_close: Don't disturb blinds that appear manually closed
data_description.manual_close_threshold_percent: Consider blinds manually closed if below this position
data_description.minimum_tilt_change_percent: Only adjust tilt if change exceeds this threshold (reduces motor wear)
data_description.enabled: Enable automatic control for this cover

apply_now.name: Apply Now
apply_now.description: Force immediate recalculation and application of slat angles to all covers, ignoring throttling rules.
